name: Rockdale County, GA
findings: Rockdale County has 403 nonprofit organizations. 131 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 101 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Rockdale County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 48 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 48 organizations here; 48% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Rockdale County list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 55% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 48% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to take civic or political action now, including outside formal organizations?
